verdict.rationale: An AI that drafts fixes and opens pull requests is a fair axis for an error-tracking platform. GlitchTip's evidence shows only a built-in MCP server that lets external AI assistants read issues and resolve or ignore them. There is no documented first-party AI that generates code fixes or opens PRs against a repo. The MCP server is a building block for other AI tools, not this capability, so it earns no credit.
